needed.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Widen and pave the footway to a minimum of 1.5m width and ensure it is clear of obstructions.

needed.evidence: footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles or other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install bollards or barriers to prevent vehicles from parking on the footway.

needed.evidence: uneven and broken sections on the footway
needed.suggestion: Repave and level the footway to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: marked crossing without refuge or signals
needed.suggestion: Install a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: crossing is hard to see and drivers do not stop
needed.suggestion: Add pedestrian signals and improve crossing visibility with raised platforms and high-contrast markings.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to ensure accessibility for pedestrians, including those with disabilities.
